summary: This class features opening remarks by Mr. Michael Mishaan at the 2023 Sephardic Community Alliance annual campaign. He reflects on the history of the organization, acknowledges key contributors, and discusses the vision of the founders in building community institutions.
questions: Who were the early leaders of the Sephardic Community Alliance?
How was the Sephardic Community Alliance established as a 501c3?
What was the original vision for the Sephardic Community Alliance?
How did the parents and grandparents of the community contribute to its institutions?
